Our Story

Where Science Meets
the Art of Beauty

Founded in the heart of Old Town Scottsdale, Lumière was born from a belief that beauty care should be both deeply personal and scientifically grounded. We source only the finest botanical and clinical formulations, delivering real, lasting results.


Our licensed estheticians and certified makeup artists bring a combined 60+ years of expertise — and an unwavering commitment to making every client feel radiant.

Nationwide Shipping
3–5 business days via USPS/UPS
$12+by weight

Delivery Hours

Monday – Friday: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Saturday: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
Sunday: Not available

Minimum Order

A $50 minimum applies to all local delivery orders. Same-day orders must be placed before 2:00 PM. We'll confirm your order and estimated window via phone or email.

Mobile Beauty Services

Select treatments including blowouts, makeup application, and skincare consultations are available as in-home services within a 10-mile radius. Contact us for availability and pricing.
